summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K with the SEC providing a routine update on its total voting rights, as required by UK Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1. The filing reports the issued share capital as of 30 June 2026: 1,551,024,534 ordinary shares (US$0.25 each) with no shares in treasury, yielding the same number of voting rights. This is a standard regulatory notification, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or other event-driven activity is disclosed.
